title: Omusika Alondeddwa
intro: Omuntu okuva mu myaka egiyise ayimiridde nga mwetegefu okulinnya mu byafaayo. Ekkubo bwe lyalabika nga teritegeerekeka bulungi era n’okubuusabuusa ne kusaasaana mu bantu, omuweereza ono yalondebwa okutwala ekyambalo ky’obulagirizi. Nga balina obuzito bw’obutume obutukuvu ku bibegabega byabwe, baagenda mu maaso okukulembera abalala gye baali balonzalonza okugoberera.
clues: Nnalondebwa okuwerekera nnabbi era nayigira ku magezi gaabwe
Nayimirira mu maaso g’Essanduuko ekisuubizo ky’Omuyimirizaawo waffe bwe kyasembera, era ne ndaba abantu nga batandise okubuusabuusa
Nakolebwa okuyimirira ku mabbali g’ebyo ebyasuubizibwa ng’omukulembeze waffe anakuwala era nga yeegayirira Allah ku lwaffe
Nalondebwa okugenda mu maaso n’obutume obwali buweereddwa omulala eyasooka nze
Nnaweebwa obuyinza obw’obwakatonda okukulembera abantu okutuuka gye baali bagenda
Nasobola okumaliriza ebyo ebyatandikibwawo mu maaso gange, era ne nfuna okukakasa kw’abantu ku bulagirizi bwange

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
